items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, rights-dependent use, or unsupported claims. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish redistribution or commercial display rights; four launch-readiness tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, measurement, and security gates are blocked; fleet security and operations evidence remain unavailable. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown, with 18 banner/consent/GA4 findings and 2 privacy plus 2 terms findings. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach, expand alerts, monetize, deploy, or change configuration. Ordinary growth is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry when existing disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, and platform boundaries are preserved.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active at 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task is closable because required direct evidence remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted storage, derivation, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or customer matching. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Concrete launch decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.

Retain the existing containment plan. Delivery is full at 10/10 slots, with 59 overflow items, 38 improvements awaiting measurement, and 17 failed implementation requests. Continue existing measurement, repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, legal/security evidence, and parked-site readiness work only. Before new queue admission, document one verified completion or justified close with ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, release, security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift.
